prompt: Write a Luau function that returns the least common multiple of two numbers.

		end
		return x
	end
	return (a * b) / gcd(a, b)
end

prompt: Write a Luau function that creates a simple event emitter using tables.
completion:
local EventEmitter = {}
EventEmitter.__index = EventEmitter

function EventEmitter.new()
	local self = setmetatable({}, EventEmitter)
	self.listeners = {}
	return self
end

function EventEmitter:on(eventName: string, callback: (...any) -> ())
	if not self.listeners[eventName] then
		self.listeners[eventName] = {}
	end
	table.insert(self.listeners[eventName], callback)
end

function EventEmitter:emit(eventName: string, ...: any)
	if self.listeners[eventName] then
		for _, callback in ipairs(self.listeners[eventName]) do
			callback(...)
		end
	end
end

return EventEmitter
